lines.text: &fThe server-wide market. Anything you list here is visible to every player online, which makes it the best place to move something quickly.
&7Type in the search field to filter lots by name, and switch the sort between &fNewest&7, &fPrice&7 and &fEnding soon&7.
&7Hover a lot to see its &6current price&7 on the first line of the tooltip - the fixed price, or the current bid on an auction. Click it to open the details.
&7A fixed-price lot is bought with &fBuy&7. The price is in Starcoins and is paid the moment you confirm. What you bought goes to your &fcollection&7, not straight into your inventory.
&7Enter an amount and press &fPlace bid&7. Your Starcoins are held while you lead and returned automatically if someone outbids you - you get a message when that happens.
&7If the seller set a &fBuyout&7, you can take the lot instantly at that price. Otherwise the highest bid wins when the time runs out and the item lands in the winner's collection.
&7Press &fCreate&7 to open the listing form. Your inventory appears while the form is open so you can pick the item to sell.
&7Set a &fPrice&7 for a fixed sale, or switch on &fAuction&7 to set a &fStarting bid&7 and an optional &fBuyout&7. Choose how many &fDays&7 it stays up, then press &fList&7.
&7You can only have a limited number of lots at once, and the Auction House may keep a cut of each sale.
&7&fCancel listing&7 takes a lot down and returns the item to your collection - but not once an auction has a bid.

&7Where your purchases and won auctions arrive, and where an expired or cancelled listing returns to. Use &fClaim all&7 to take everything. &cCheck it&7 &8- items wait for you there and are not delivered on their own.
&8Selling to a specific player instead? A vending block does that, and does not take a listing slot.
